4+ years. 70,000+ orders. 4.5 stars from 11,000+ reviews. Zomato's Best Sandwich in #Kolkata 2025 Award.

Sandwhich Bar didn't get here by accident. We got here by showing up consistently, keeping quality non-negotiable, and building real trust with #Kolkata's food community.

Now we're ready for the next outlet and we're looking for the right space to grow into.

📍 We are actively scouting for a commercial space on rent in:

→ Hindustan Park
→ Gariahat
→ Bhowanipore
→ Southern Avenue

📋 Space requirements:

• Size: 500–700 sq. ft - Ground Floor
• Frontage: 8–10 ft, main road facing
• Water connection: Mandatory
• Electricity: 15–17 KW load
• Washroom: Personal / shared / nearby — all acceptable
• Fire NOC: Not required — we operate on fully electric equipment

If you are a property owner, broker, or someone with leads in these areas, we would appreciate you reaching out directly.

And if this isn't relevant to you, a share to the right person could make all the difference. Kolkata's networks are tight. Someone in your circle likely knows the right space.

📧 help@houselveskitchen.com
